nodes.text: An eight-month-old baby was detected with HMPV in Bengaluru, making it the first such case in the city. The case came to notice in Baptist Hospital in the northern part of the city. However, the Karnataka health department clarified it didn’t get the sample tested in their labs. https://t.co/riek7CI6tM
